title: Collab-Solver: Collaborative Solving Policy Learning for Mixed-Integer Linear Programming
abstract: arXiv:2508.03030v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) has been a fundamental problem in combinatorial optimization. Conventional MILP solving mainly relies on carefully designed heuristics embedded in the branch-and-bound framework. Driven by the strong capabilities of neural networks, recent research is exploring the value of machine learning alongside conventional MILP solving. Although learning-based MILP methods have shown great promise, existing works typically learn policies for individual modules in MILP solvers in isolation, without considering their interdependence, which limits both solving efficiency and solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose Collab-Solver, a novel multi-agent-based policy learning framework for MILP that enables collaborative policy optimization for multiple modules. translated_title: Collab-Solver：面向混合整数线性规划的协同求解策略学习
translated_abstract: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）一直是组合优化中的一个基础性问题。传统的MILP求解主要依赖于嵌入在分支定界框架中的精心设计的启发式方法。在神经网络强大能力的驱动下，近期的研究正在探索机器学习与传统MILP求解相结合的价值。尽管基于学习的MILP方法已展现出巨大潜力，但现有工作通常孤立地为MILP求解器中的各个模块学习策略，而未考虑它们之间的相互依赖关系，这限制了求解效率和解的质量。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了Collab-Solver，这是一种新颖的基于多智能体的MILP策略学习框架，能够对多个模块进行协同策略优化。具体而言，我们将MILP求解中割平面选择与分支之间的协作形式化为一个Stackelberg博弈。在这种形式化框架下……
tldr: 提出了Collab-Solver，一个基于多智能体的策略学习框架，通过将割平面选择与分支的协作建模为Stackelberg博弈，实现MILP求解器多个模块的协同策略优化，从而同时提升求解效率和解的质量。
en_tdlr: Collab-Solver is a novel multi-agent policy learning framework that formulates the collaboration between cut selection and branching as a Stackelberg game, enabling collaborative policy optimization across multiple MILP solver modules to improve both solving efficiency and solution quality.
